maker.label: The Studio
maker.headline: Made one piece at a time in Portland
maker.body: I work from a small studio bench in Portland, Oregon, using recycled gold and silver sourced through audited refiners. Every stone comes with a paper trail. Most pieces exist once. When a one-of-a-kind ring sells, that exact combination of metal and stone is gone.

photo.prompt: Natural light portrait of a focused female jeweler at a wooden workbench in a small Portland studio, hands working on a metal ring with small tools, warm window light from the left, shallow depth of field, fine details of tools and metal scraps visible, quiet and authentic maker portrait
photo.alt: Jeweler working at her studio bench in Portland, Oregon
